test_name: Rumble room player cap value and enforcement - 1b84a31f-43ad-4dd1-b2ec-e96e5451f523
summary: Inconclusive because the fix was tested on a local test server only, not in the game: it needs the server published and a full Rumble to see it live. The real Rumble cap was 8, not 6 - the questionnaire was right. The cap was already enforced on elevator joins, late joins, merges between rounds and rejoins, and is now 6. One gap was fixed: at round end, a room bigger than the cap moved as one group into a smaller room and nobody could take a seat. It now splits into rooms of at most 6.
